title: DSPy Signature Definition
summary: This module defines the core structure and behavior of DSPy Signatures, including a metaclass for dynamic creation and validation, and utilities for handling legacy field definitions.

nodes.label: Manage DSPy Signatures
nodes.title: DSPy Signature Metaclass
nodes.description: A metaclass that extends Pydantic's BaseModel metaclass to define DSPy Signatures. It handles dynamic signature creation, field validation, type inference, instruction generation, and ensures proper field metadata for input/output fields.

nodes.label: Convert Field to Old Format
nodes.title: Field Format Converter
nodes.description: Converts a modern Pydantic FieldInfo object, which includes DSPy-specific metadata, into an older OldInputField or OldOutputField instance based on its type for backward compatibility.

nodes.label: Old Input Field
nodes.title: Legacy Input Field Definition
nodes.description: Represents a legacy input field definition within DSPy, inheriting from OldField and marking itself as an input field. Used for backward compatibility with older field representations.

nodes.label: Old Output Field
nodes.title: Legacy Output Field Definition
nodes.description: Represents a legacy output field definition within DSPy, inheriting from OldField and marking itself as an output field. Used for backward compatibility with older field representations.

nodes.label: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.title: Pydantic Base Model
nodes.description: An external Pydantic class that provides the foundation for data validation and settings management, extended by DSPy's SignatureMeta.

nodes.label: Pydantic FieldInfo
nodes.title: Pydantic Field Information
nodes.description: An external Pydantic class that holds metadata about a model field, which DSPy's SignatureMeta processes to define input and output fields.

groups.label: Signature Core Definition
groups.title: Core Signature Definition
groups.description: Components responsible for defining and managing the fundamental structure and behavior of DSPy Signatures.

groups.label: Legacy Field Handling
groups.title: Legacy Field Compatibility
groups.description: Components that provide backward compatibility for older DSPy field definitions and conversion utilities.
